title: COLD FEET
logline: Frank, a gentle stitched-together giant who is terrified of fire, and Nefi, a 3,000-year-old mummy who is always cold, try to keep their marriage (and their furnace) running.
rules: Hook in the first 3 seconds: open on a line, never on a logo.
Every episode ends on a cliffhanger or a 'next episode' tease.
Home-service facts must be accurate and safe: no DIY gas or electrical work shown as a good idea; when an alarm sounds, get outside first.
Original character designs only (no Universal-style flat-top head and neck bolts).

characters.name: Frank
characters.role: Husband. A huge, gentle monster stitched together from spare parts. Brought to life by lightning.

look.details: messy black hair, stitches across forehead and left cheek, round electrode scar on the right temple, heavy brow, square jaw, no neck bolts

outfits.cardigan: brown knit cardigan #8B5E3C over gray shirt, charcoal trousers, black boots

characters.name: Nefi
characters.role: Wife. A 3,000-year-old mummy and former royal. Dry humor. Always cold.

look.details: linen wraps with darker wrap lines, kohl-lined amber eyes through an eye slit, gold headband with blue stone, gold and lapis collar

outfits.blanket: wraps plus a purple fringed blanket over the shoulders

characters.name: Dee
characters.role: HVAC technician from the sponsor brand. Calm, kind, a little amused by monsters.

look.details: navy uniform with brand-orange cap and logo patch, tool belt, short beard

characters.name: Narrator
characters.role: Off-screen announcer for recaps and teasers.

locations.living-room: Small cozy living room at night: window with moon, lamp, couch, thermostat and a CO alarm on the wall.
locations.basement: Concrete basement with the furnace, pipes and wooden stairs.
locations.outside: Front yard at night with light snow and the house behind.
